## Intake review

**Related:** #2062 (design §7), #2317/#2318 (F1/F2 dependencies), #2321 (the PoC whose cluster this audits)

**Notes:** Graph↔ledger reconciliation + supply-audit job for the currency control plane. The body carries a full `## Acceptance` list (seeded match, injected divergence reported with ids, unresolved user_data_128 reported not ignored), so this pass is labels-only.

**Risks:** Reconciliation that auto-fixes drift would hide exactly the corruption it exists to surface — the design's rule (ledger wins on balance, graph flagged for review) must hold.

**Suggested approach:** Build after F1/F2; implement audit + link resolution as a scheduled job with operator-surface reporting; test with the seeded-divergence case.

🤖 **Agent note** · claimed — Lane JX (archer, sandbox fix lane)

- **Task:** #2320 F4 slice per the 2026-11-23 decision (comment above): implement the report-only graph↔ledger reconciliation + supply-audit job (§7.1–§7.3 of the currency control plane design) with named-oracle tests.
- **Premise check (fresh):** #2320 OPEN; #2319 and #2321 both CLOSED (PR #12960 merged); no live claim on this slice after the decision routed it as task 21144 (queue backend down, so claiming here on the issue).
- **Scope guard:** report-only — no repair, deletion, rewrite, deployment, or production scheduling, per the decision's own terms.

**Lane JX done record — the F4 report-only reconciliation + supply-audit packet has landed.**

[PR #13139](https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/13139) merged as `c2355a3f6ff4cf8dcc747bcffb3ddb9b45ee6cdb` (branch head `45fcf5ec9a1b`).

What landed, against the acceptance criteria:

- **(a) Match on a seeded cluster** — `GatewayPoc::reconcile(recent_limit)` runs the audit for every registered currency; test `reconcile_reports_match_for_seeded_cluster`: issue 100 → Alice, transfer 40 → Bob reports supply 100 = 100, no findings, 2 transfers checked.
- **(b) Injected divergence reported with currency, ledger, and object** — `reconcile_reports_amount_drift_with_currency_ledger_and_object`: a transfer posted directly to the ledger reusing a real graph stamp but a different amount reports `AmountDrift { ledger, transfer_id, graph_event, graph_amount: 40, ledger_amount: 7 }` (ledger wins, graph flagged, per §7.2). `reconcile_reports_supply_mismatch_when_supply_leaves_audited_accounts` reports `SupplyMismatch { issued: 100, accounted: 90 }` with the currency and ledger on the report.
- **(c) Unresolved objects reported, never dropped** — `reconcile_reports_unresolved_graph_link`: a stamped transfer with no graph event reports `UnresolvedGraphLink`. Backend read failures likewise surface as `LedgerReadFailed` findings — the report states its own blindness rather than reading as a match. Zero-stamp transfers are counted as `unstamped_transfers`, not findings.

Shape: new `currency::reconcile` module (design §7.1–§7.3); `LedgerBackend` gained defaulted fallible enumeration reads (`try_accounts_on_ledger` / `try_transfers_on_ledger`) whose default is an explicit error. `InMemoryLedger` implements both; the TigerBeetle backend implements transfer enumeration via paged `query_transfers` — the pinned client (0.17.9) has no ledger-scoped account query, so against a real cluster the supply half currently reports `LedgerReadFailed` until a client capability or an account-id index exists. That is the honest state of the TB leg, recorded here rather than papered over.

Verification: `cargo check -p id --features world` clean; `cargo test -p id --features world,currency-poc-tb --lib currency` — 142 passed, 0 failed (10 ignored = live-cluster tests), re-run green on the final formatted tree. Touched files rustfmt-clean (edition 2024). Full-crate clippy was started locally but not completed (laptop under heavy multi-lane load); CI on main carries it.

Scope kept per the 2026-11-23 routing decision: report-only — no repair, deletion, rewrite, deployment, or production scheduling. **What remains on this issue:** wiring `reconcile` into a scheduled job against a deployed gateway (production scheduling — needs its own go-ahead), and a TigerBeetle account-enumeration route for the supply half. The queue completion for task 21144 rides the issue record + lease expiry while the sandbox queue leg is down.

Progress from OpenChamber lane oc-code-03: the F4 report-only API and its scenario oracles were already present on main via #13139. I added the missing property-based supply aggregation/divergence oracles in #13166. Focused local tests pass; remote Fleet verification is running at https://github.com/developing-today-forks/fleet/actions/runs/45149906659. I have not closed #2320 or claimed production scheduling/deployment.

Progress: PR #13166 remains open. The Fleet run for the focused verification reached a terminal failure before tests ran: Nix aborted during environment setup with `home directory "/homeless-shelter" exists; please remove it to assure purity of builds without sandboxing` (run: https://github.com/developing-today-forks/fleet/actions/runs/45149906659). This is runner/setup failure, not a test assertion result. Resume by rerunning focused verification on a compatible runner, then verify disposition after the PR merges. #2320 remains open.
